concept.title: IP Addresses and DHCP
concept.shortdesc: IP addresses enable devices to communicate on a network. DHCP automatically assigns IP addresses to connected devices.

section.title: Overview
section.p: Every device on a network requires a unique IP address.
An IP address identifies a device and enables communication between network devices.

section.title: Understanding IP Addresses
section.p: An IP address is similar to a mailing address.
It helps network devices identify and communicate with each other.
In this guide, a client device may receive an address such as .

section.title: IPv4 Addressing
section.p: The home network uses the protocol.
Devices communicate by using unique IPv4 addresses within the configured subnet.
The subnet mask defines the network boundary.

section.title: What is DHCP?
section.p: DHCP automatically assigns IP addresses to devices when they join the network.
This eliminates the need to manually configure an IP address for each device.

section.title: DHCP Address Assignment
